findings.title: RFork community comparison omits rc2 protocol changes
findings.impact: Readers may apply the work-version key, ports, lease and planner protocol to rc2; old planner lacks required LEASE_TTL_SEC header.
findings.fix: Keep 3284850b teaching scope, add independent rc2 matrix and protocol instructions; link from all RFork chapters.

findings.title: Generated prefetch_ratio path omits weight_prefetch_config
findings.impact: Copying generated path into v0.23 additional_config silently does not apply ratio.
findings.fix: Correct nested identity in page and scanner data so next sync cannot reintroduce top-level path.

findings.title: Average layer-shard memory presented as every-card budget
findings.impact: 61 layers do not divide 16 ranks; peak rank needs 4*112+224=672MiB, not651; 3-layer ranks need560MiB under same assumptions.
findings.fix: Use modulo layer owners, distinguish average and per-rank peak; correct receive-traffic average in next paragraph.

findings.title: KVPP owner formula missing PCP coordinate for rc2
findings.impact: TP rank modulo size repeats across PCP ranks; reader cannot derive actual rc2 owners.
findings.fix: Separate old formula from rc2 PCP_rank*TP+TP_rank / get_kvpp_group rank; keep PP-local and draft exclusions.

findings.title: Lease occupancy ends too early in startup overview
findings.impact: Reader may treat read completion as source capacity release, conflicting with asynchronous acknowledgement and TTL.
findings.fix: State reads stop needing bytes then, but planner capacity remains until release or expiry; link lifecycle.

findings.title: Current rc2 additions conflict with unqualified historical claims
findings.impact: Still says no pinned version can run STAIR, while rc2 is pinned and connected; defaults1 stated unqualified after rc2 defaults-1. Similar residue remains in SFA/fused-op pages.
findings.fix: Make historical subheadings explicit and remove generic all-pins/main-only claims; promote common current scope to central table.

findings.title: Formal pages retain maintenance audit paragraphs
findings.impact: Source numbers, raw archive line ranges, first-person verification process interrupt learner explanation and repeat facts.
findings.fix: After checking cited source, keep useful behavior/limits in teaching and move audit provenance to reviews; do not delete uncertainty without evidence.

findings.title: bool(int) described as accepting only0/1
findings.impact: Nonzero valid integers such as2/-1 also mapTrue.
findings.fix: Recommend0/1 but accurately state parser and invalid true string.

findings.title: Generic size lineage lists unrelated matches as parameter history
findings.impact: Hundreds of size occurrences and2025 introduction are unrelated to KVPPConfig.size despite warning.
findings.fix: Remove ambiguous generated lineage or use qualified field/definition-specific lineage.

findings.title: Nested fuse_allreduce_rms incorrectly described as Omni-filtered top-level key
findings.impact: Initial rc2 paragraph incorrectly allowed nested key in Omni.
findings.fix: Latest paragraph correctly says nested strict validation rejects it.

findings.title: main-only declarations contradicted newly tracked rc2
findings.impact: Combine,force-EPLB,embedding and several other pages said onlymain.
findings.fix: Several scope paragraphs corrected during review; check final complete revision after concurrent edits finish.
